observations.footwork: Wide stance, feet planted, slight forward pressure.
observations.guard: Left hand up, right hand extended after a punch.
observations.upper_body: Right arm fully extended forward at shoulder height.
observations.notable: Punch extended at start of sequence.

observations.footwork: Stepping forward, closing distance on the pad holder.
observations.guard: Right hand retracting to guard, left hand stays high.
observations.upper_body: Torso rotating slightly right to load the next punch.
observations.distance: Closing, getting closer to the pad holder.
observations.notable: Clear forward step and re-loading of the rear hand.

observations.footwork: Stepping back, re-establishing a wider base.
observations.guard: Hands return to a high, active guard position.
observations.upper_body: Slight rotation as the punch retracts, then settling.
observations.notable: Punch extension followed by a deliberate step back.

observations.footwork: Stepping forward slightly to initiate the next combination.
observations.guard: Right hand begins to extend for another punch.
observations.upper_body: Full extension of the right arm again.
observations.distance: Closing back in to pad range.
observations.notable: Repeated pattern of forward step and rear-hand strike.

observations.footwork: Stabilizing into a neutral fighting stance.
observations.guard: Both hands up in a ready position.
observations.upper_body: Facing the pad holder, ready for the next instruction.

movement_events.detail: Rear hand retracting from full extension back toward guard.
Fighter steps forward with rear foot, closing the distance.
Right hand extends fully forward to strike the pads.
Fighter steps back to original range after the strike.
Another rear-hand punch is thrown and extended.
Punch retracts and fighter begins another step.
Fighter settles into a stable, ready stance.
